payload.title: Gate each candidate commit: line 5's skill scripts, skillcheck, go vet and go test
payload.body: Rule, set before any candidate commit. Per target, on its subject commit: (1) each skills/*/SKILL.md changed vs 7825275 passes quick_validate.py (sha256 d81f883a…) with exit 0, and lint_cruft.py --routing (sha256 ff36baef…) with high=0, both under uv run --with PyYAML==6.0.3; (2) go vet ./... and go test ./... -count=1 pass, skillcheck included; (3) H-AAHHZ1 only: TestPromptPrintsTheGoalsRunPrompt is red on 7825275, green on the candidate, and red with the default set back to 5. Supports if all hold, else contradicts.

why: Line G-908PRZ#5 is a per-commit gate; run it before the replay trials so a failing commit is fixed before it costs trials.

payload.title: Replay cut A and cut B three times per arm and score reviews, selects, stop names and cost
payload.body: Rule, set before any trial. Arms: base (skills at 7825275, N 5) and each target's commit; 3 Sonnet trials per arm at cut A (b4f23b2, actor claude-g113-1) and cut B (3cfd08d, actor claude-g113-3), limit 100 min. Per target: #1 a1 in >=2 of 3 cut-A trials; #2 b2 in >=2 of 3 cut-B trials; #3 ratio <=1.5 at both cuts; #4 l4 in all 6. A timed-out trial fails a1 and b2. Supports if #1-#4 hold, else contradicts. a1_strict, b2_strict and l4_strict test the other readings and set no verdict. A trial whose runner never starts runs once more.

why: Lines G-908PRZ#1-#4 are measured on replays of the goal-prompt run; one Experiment covers every candidate and the base.
The candidate is commit a0bcc09 on feat/run-review, with no patch.

payload.title: Fresh subagent review of each candidate commit's diff against the Goal's lines
payload.body: Rule, set before the reviews. One fresh subagent per target reads git diff 2cea6c2 <commit>, the Hypothesis body, Q-8YMFW1's method and G-908PRZ's lines, and labels each finding with a line or none. A case of a line no check ran is one --limit here; a defect in text the Goal lets me edit is a fix commit; a finding of no line goes to the stop checkpoint. Contradicts a target if a finding shows by reading that its text breaks #4 (tells a run to stop with an unreviewed candidate unnamed) or #5; else supports.

why: hyp-goal-run asks for one fresh review of each candidate commit before the stop; run it while the trials run.

payload.observation: Six fresh reviews (one per commit, diff vs 2cea6c2) report no text that tells a run to stop with an unreviewed candidate unnamed, and none that breaks #5. Ten cases of lines #1, #3, #4 that no check ran are the limits. Text defects (reserve-last F2, probe-closes F3/F7, whole-candidate F5, one-experiment F2) get fix commits on the candidates the replay leaves standing; findings of no line go to the stop checkpoint.
limits: whole-candidate F1, G-908PRZ#1: a run builds C1, fixes to C2 and C3, and reviews only C3, as 'one review replaces a review of each fix commit' says; C1 and C2 end with no review Result.
whole-candidate F2, G-908PRZ#4: the review is tied to the select; a run that stops on its budget with no select owed asks for no review, and nothing names the unreviewed candidate.
name-at-stop F2, G-908PRZ#4: with many unreviewed candidates and AWAITING OWNER keys, the stop summary passes 600 runes; hyp refuses it, or the run trims the unreviewed names.
reserve-last F3, G-908PRZ#1: the rule fires only at exactly one Result left; Results spent on readings or limit closes leave zero at the next commit, which then has no review Result.
one-experiment F1, G-908PRZ#4: the gate-plus-review Result of C1 finds a text defect at the budget's end; the fix C2 is committed with no Result left and the stop checkpoint does not name it.
one-experiment F3, G-908PRZ#1: a review with cases of lines adds limit-closing Results, so a candidate costs more than one Result and the budget can end before the select.
raise-budget F1, G-908PRZ#4: with skill text unchanged, readings, limit closes and reassess Results fill all 7 before the review; the run stops on an unreviewed candidate it does not name.
raise-budget F3, G-908PRZ#3: a run that stopped at its 5th Result can record two more before the stop clause, so its median cost can pass 1.5 times the base at N 5.
probe-closes F4, G-908PRZ#1: k probes run before the review Result is recorded; with N 5 the budget ends before the review Result exists.
probe-closes F2, G-908PRZ#1: one passing probe of a narrow finding is recorded as --closes on a whole Goal line, which no replay of that line ran.

why: Records E-PMK8H9 under its pre-registered rule.

payload.observation: On each commit, every changed SKILL.md (hyp-goal-run; hyp-owner-grill for d0e8591) gives quick_validate.py exit 0 'Skill is valid!' and lint_cruft.py --routing high=0; go vet and go test ./... -count=1 exit 0, skillcheck ok. d0e8591: TestPromptPrintsTheGoalsRunPrompt fails on 7825275's prompt.go, passes on the candidate, and fails with the default set back to 5.

why: Records E-S9A619 under its pre-registered rule.

payload.observation: 42 trials, none timed out. a1 passes in 0 of 3 cut-A trials and b2 in 0 of 3 cut-B trials for every arm, base included, so #1 and #2 fail for all six. Cost ratio at cut A: one-experiment 1.44, name-at-stop 1.01, probe-closes 1.61, raise-budget 1.85, reserve-last 1.52, whole-candidate 0.87; at cut B all <=1.32. #4: reserve-last fails one trial (rr-reserve-last-a-1). Runs did ask subagents, but cited the runner's summary or no Result at all, so no Result met the review definition.
limits: G-908PRZ#1 and #2: score reads 'a review written by a subagent' as a cited file holding the subagent's own text. No check ran the reading 'the runner's summary of that review'; by results-and-selects.txt it would not lift any candidate over all four lines.
G-908PRZ#3: total_cost_usd is the session's cost-state total; whether it holds the subagents' own cost was not checked, so an arm that spends more on reviews may be under-counted.

why: Records E-XVFAZ6 under its pre-registered rule.

payload.title: feat/run-review: a review is a Result citing the subagent's own reply, before any select
payload.body: The review of a candidate is recorded as its review Result: the subagent's reply saved word for word and cited by a Result that gives the candidate a verdict, inside its gate Experiment so it costs no extra Result. No select of a candidate without one; the stop checkpoint names each candidate that lacks one. Built as a commit that changes skills/hyp-goal-run. From R-4XNFHN: every arm asked subagents, but runs cited a summary or no Result.

why: OWED owes rivals after R-4XNFHN ruled out all six; this one targets the gap every arm, base included, showed.
Tie the candidate before its gate, review and replay.

limits: G-908PRZ#1, #2: the text names git show <commit>, the delta against the parent, not git diff <base> <commit>; a fix commit's review misses defects carried from the commit before it.
G-908PRZ#1, #3: the text does not order the review before the gate's Result is recorded; a run that records the gate first spends a second Result on the review.
G-908PRZ#1: the pre-registered verdict rule does not name the review or what its findings do to the verdict.
G-908PRZ#3: each fix commit is a new candidate and gets its own review, a review chain on small changes; no text lets a fix reuse its predecessor's review.
G-908PRZ#1: a candidate committed after the last Result is used is built but never gated, so never reviewed; the text has no rule against it.
G-908PRZ#1, #2: 'Review each candidate before any select of it' reads as every candidate or only a candidate to be selected.
G-908PRZ#1, #2: 'Give it the code' lets a runner paste a summary, so the subagent's transcript may not hold the diff.

payload.title: Probe: does claude -p's total_cost_usd include a subagent's usage?
payload.body: Rule, set before the probe. One claude -p --model sonnet --output-format json session (claude 2.1.322) in an empty scratch dir, no repo, tools Agent and Read only, asked to spawn one general-purpose subagent that reads one small file and replies. Compare output tokens: included if modelUsage's summed outputTokens >= 0.95 x (main transcript + subagent transcript output tokens, each message id once); excluded if it is within 5% of the main transcript's alone. H-SFEA2M: supports if included (cut-A ratio 1.4573 stands), inconclusive if excluded or neither.

why: Limits R-4XNFHN#2 and R-YNB43F#2 ask whether #3's cost counts review subagents; the kept records cannot decide it.

payload.observation: claude 2.1.322, Sonnet: modelUsage outputTokens 486 = main transcript 315 + subagent transcript 171; every token kind sums exactly, and costUSD equals total_cost_usd 0.0677498. total_cost_usd includes the subagent's usage, so #3's medians count review subagents.

why: Records E-2A6FW1 under its pre-registered rule: included.

payload.observation: Same rule and trials as R-YNB43F (inputs pin ea697bf). s0brxe-cases.txt names where three R-S0BRXE cases ran: b-3 reviewed every commit of a 3-commit fix chain (#1); a-3 committed a candidate at the budget's end and named it at the stop (#5); a-1 and a-2 recorded review limits and stopped before a select, while cut B selected within N in 3 of 3 (#6).

why: Closes the R-S0BRXE cases the replay ran for the live candidate; the rest are void for it and are referred.

payload.summary: Stopped: 10 Results recorded under claude-g141-1. H-SFEA2M (ea697bf) supports on lines #1-#5 (R-XT3JRJ, R-YNB43F, R-T2WJ7V); unselected. Candidates not reviewed: none live. Void for every live candidate: it names reserve-last's one-Result-left rule; R-4XNFHN contradicts that rival and H-SFEA2M has no such rule.

Void for every live candidate: it names probe-closes's --closes of a line on one probe; H-SFEA2M has no probe step, and its line closes come from the E-2TJK2N replay.
